name: Zoom Events Google Calendar
author: Aurelien Navarre
description: Shows your current or next Zoom meeting from Google Calendar in the bar.

barWidget.description: Calendar icon and title of the next Zoom meeting from your Google Calendar.

schema.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often the calendar feed is downloaded.

schema.label: Look ahead (hours)
schema.description: Only show meetings starting within this many hours.

schema.label: Meetings in the panel
schema.description: How many upcoming meetings the panel lists, across as many days as needed.

schema.label: Text size
schema.description: How large the panel's text reads: small, medium, large or xlarge (extra large).
